subject: maths
topic: Simple and compound interest, profit and loss

kept.q: Chidi deposits ₦60,000 in a bank that pays simple interest at 8% per annum. Find the total amount in his account after 5 years.
kept.explanation: Simple interest = (P x R x T)/100 = (60000 x 8 x 5)/100 = ₦24,000. Amount = Principal + Interest = 60000 + 24000 = ₦84,000.

kept.q: A trader bought 50 bags of garri at ₦18,000 per bag, spending ₦900,000 in total. She sold 30 of the bags at a profit of 10% per bag, and the remaining 20 bags at a loss of 5% per bag. Find her overall percentage profit on the whole transaction.
kept.pidgin: Sale from the 30 bags wey get profit = 30 x 18000 x 1.10 = ₦594,000. Sale from the 20 bags wey get loss = 20 x 18000 x 0.95 = ₦342,000. Total sale = ₦936,000, profit be 936000 - 900000 = ₦36,000, wey be 4% of the ₦900,000 wey she spend.

kept.q: A sum of money invested at compound interest, compounded annually at 10% per annum, amounts to ₦242,000 after 2 years. Find the principal invested.
kept.pidgin: Amount = P(1 + R/100)^T, so 242000 = P x (1.1)^2 = P x 1.21. If you divide 242000 by 1.21, you go get P = ₦200,000.

kept.q: Emeka invests ₦150,000 at simple interest. After 4 years, the total amount in his account becomes ₦198,000. Find the rate of interest per annum.
